The research

Three directions. One atelier.

Each sub-cluster has a broad purpose. The examples below show research currently underway.

01

Artificer Lab

Automation, Robotics, Techno-Integration & Fabrication in Chemical and Engineering Research

Purpose
Build tools for chemistry through mechatronics and other interdisciplinary combinations.
General direction
Custom measurements, sensing, automation, and integrated laboratory instruments.
Principle
Start with a chemical need; test the tool’s performance.
Current examples
Multispectral and gas sensors; DIY goniometers; splash measurement devices.
02

PRIME Lab

Polymer Research in Materials Engineering Design Laboratory

Purpose
Advance polymer research across sources, methods, properties, and applications.
General direction
Polymer chemistry, processing, characterization, and material design.
Principle
Relate structure and processing to material properties.
Current examples
Synthetic and biobased polymers; processing natural polymers and fibers.
03

Kampilan

Kapnayan ng Material na Pamana, Imbestigasyon, Likhain, tungo sa pag-Angat Nasyonalismo

Purpose
Use chemistry to study, document, and interpret cultural heritage.
General direction
Chemical study of heritage materials, methods, and changes over time.
Principle
Keep historical context and material provenance in view.
Current examples
Colors and chemistry of heritage dyes.

The current examples illustrate each sub-cluster’s work; they do not set its research limits.

Our approach

Chemistry in conversation with other fields.

Chemist Atelier brings together instrument development, polymer materials, and heritage research. Each direction asks a different question, while sharing an emphasis on careful measurement, material evidence, and useful interpretation.
